**EIPIP meeting today at 16:00 UTC!**

A few important discussions on the agenda:

- AI in the EIP ecosystem: AGENTS.md & EIP Builder
- Keeper of Consensus election
- EIP Coordinator role & EIP-1 update
- Glamsterdam EIP updates
- Improving PR reviews and the editorial process

Everyone interested in improving Ethereum’s EIP/ERC process is welcome to participate.

Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2288
